obsolete_package_name_note: 'python-chess' was the old PyPI project name for this library; it is obsolete and must not be used. The current, correct PyPI package name is 'chess'.
dependency_boundary: Only medium_pc_audit/pgn_parse.py and medium_pc_audit/position_extract.py may import the third-party `chess` package. Their corresponding tests may also import it. The remaining medium_pc_audit control, provenance, analysis, and evidence modules remain stdlib-only.
verification_method: pip download chess==1.11.2 --no-binary :all: --no-deps -d . ; sha256sum of the resulting sdist tarball
